# Support

## Questions and usage help

Use GitHub Discussions or open an issue with the question and a minimal
reproduction. Include the Zenthrix version, Python version, operating system,
hardware target, and the exact command or code involved.

## Bug reports

Use the bug report template for reproducible defects. Remove credentials,
private model weights, proprietary binaries, and other sensitive information
before submitting logs or configuration.

## Security issues

Do not report security vulnerabilities in public issues. Follow the process in
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
